title: Klammerdiagramm — rājarṣivaṃśaḥ
desc: German-Indological bracket diagram of the three-member LEFT-nested compound rāja-ṛṣi-vaṃśaḥ: deepest node A = rāja+ṛṣi (rājarṣi, the king-sage), mirrored node B = [A]+vaṃśaḥ — the lineage of royal sages. II часть begins at vaṃśaḥ (asked, per contract). Unsandhied segmented members, full word form.
